description: T-5123 (T-2851's plain-range shapes): one delete_row of rows 6-8 (count 3) across the last edge of a plain range, no table: S!C1:C10 hold 1..10. Sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!C4:C7) (its last two rows go: does it shrink to S!C4:C5?), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(S!$C$4:$C$7), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3). plain-range-delete-rows-across-edge F!A5:A6 answers the relative form for another range (S!C2:C4 under rows 3-5); the absolute form at the last edge is new.
